_comment: Structural numbers that scripts/check_report_numbers.py (DESIGN §13.5) does not require a source for. Each entry: id, regex (matched on the report line; a number lying inside a match is exempt) and reason. Results are never exempt: keep this list short and structural.

exemptions.reason: section numbers of DESIGN.md / REPORT.md
publication and calendar years (citations such as Tsherniak 2017)
dates and timestamps
ordered-list numbering
heading numbering
row numbering in a table's first column
bold section labels (DESIGN style **8.3**)
top-k list sizes defined in DESIGN §6.1 / §10.5 (primary_endpoints.json: P2 k = 200, secondary 100 / 500)
null draw counts defined in DESIGN §7.1-§7.2 (B 20, raised 50; rerun 10)
gate attempt index (results/gate_iterations.csv row number)
confidence level of every interval in DESIGN (95%)
thresholds of frozen DESIGN rules stated as inequalities (q < 0.05, >= 5 carriers, share >= 0.25); observed results are written with '=' or plainly and must be cited
project part label
report layout defined in DESIGN §12.3 (top 15 shortlist rows, three case studies)
failure-class codes defined in DESIGN §12.1–12.2 (labels such as class 9 or class-3, not quantities)
licence version labels (CC BY 4.0, GPL-2.0)
the 2×2 arm design label (DESIGN §5.1)
short git commit hashes (7 hex characters); report counts of 1,000 or more always carry thousands commas, so a bare 7-character token is a hash
clock times of runs (e.g. 08:49)
dictionary feature ids FAMILY:<Entrez> and Entrez gene ids (identifiers, not quantities)
item number in LESSONS.md (a reference label)
numbering of the worked examples in §6.5
